landing_subtitle: Learn Hangul, build muscle memory, and practice typing with interactive feedback.
feature_1_desc: Train your fingers to naturally find the 2-Set layout keys.
feature_3_desc: Smart exercises based on your weakest keys.
progress_heatmap_desc: Keys marked in red are causing the most errors. The system will adapt to train these.
progress_no_data: Complete a practice session to see your stats.
progress_reset_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset all your progress?
learn_subtitle: Understand how the Korean 2-Set keyboard maps to physical keys.
learn_concept_1_desc: Consonants are on the left side. Vowels are on the right side.
learn_concept_2_desc: Type the initial consonant, then the vowel, and finally the bottom consonant (batchim).
learn_interactive_desc: See how a full syllable is constructed from raw keyboard inputs.
learn_concept_3_desc: Hold the Shift key to access double consonants (like ㅃ) and compound vowels (like ㅒ).
